snippet.title: You won’t survive even a single shift! Rules Motel Horizon Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://outnord-games.itch.io/rules-motel-horizon

Horizon Motel — a horror game about a night administrator.
21 shifts, strange rules, and guests who are not always human…

Horizon Motel — dream job or nightmare?
You’ve been hired as the night administrator with a massive paycheck. 21 shifts to survive — sounds simple? It’s not.

This motel has strange rules you must obey. Not all guests are human, and your decisions may cost you your life. Inspect documents, observe behavior, and decide: check them in or refuse.

⚡ Upgrade your gear with the merchant, balance between the Cult and the Church, keep order… and most importantly — stay alive.

Can you survive all 21 nights and uncover the secrets of Horizon Motel?

🔗 https://linktr.ee/outnordgames 

🎥 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and comment — would you dare to work here?
